# What the Archicad API *can't do.*

Tapir uses the Archicad API that Graphisoft publishes for add-ons, and covers all of it that can be a JSON command. What that API does not offer, Tapir cannot offer either. This page lists what people ask for that is not in it, with what to do instead.

## The *list.*

It is also what Tapir would like the Archicad API to offer, and the list Tapir sends to Graphisoft. Every row was checked in the headers of the Archicad API DevKits of Archicad 25 to 30, the versions Tapir is built for; the Evidence column names the headers and functions.

| What people want | Status | What to do instead | Evidence | Issue |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Elements | | | | |
| Explode an element into its parts, as Edit > Reshape > Explode into Current View does | Not possible | Nothing yet | No explode function in `ACAPinc.h`, the `ACAPI_*.h` headers or the `ACAPI::` modules (AC25–AC30). `APIAttrCreationMethod_Explode` (`APIdefs_Attributes.h`) only tells how an attribute was created. | – |
| Anchor the sill or header of a window or door to the project zero or to a reference level | Workaround | Anchor it to a story with `verticalLink` `SillToStory` or `HeaderToStory` in [ModifyWindows](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ModifyWindows) or [ModifyDoors](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ModifyDoors), and work out the height from the story level ([GetStories](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetStories)). | `API_VerticalLinkID` (`APIdefs_Elements.h`, AC25–AC30) has only the wall bottom, the wall top and a story as the anchor of a window or door (`API_LinkSillTo…`, `API_LinkHeaderTo…`); there is no value for the project zero or a reference level. | [#2575](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2575) |
| A camera with a name of its own, or an axonometric camera | Partly possible | Name the Camera Set the camera is in. For an axonometric view, set the 3D window with [Set3DProjectionSettings](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#Set3DProjectionSettings). | `API_CameraType` holds only `head`, `camSetGuid` and `perspCam` (`API_PerspCamPars`); only `API_CamSetType` has a `name` (`APIdefs_Elements.h`, AC25–AC30). | [#2192](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2192) |
| Remove one direction of a trim between two roofs or shells that trim each other | Workaround | Remove the trim with [RemoveElementTrims](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#RemoveElementTrims), which removes both directions, then trim the other direction again with [TrimElements](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#TrimElements). | The only removal function, `ACAPI_Element_Trim_Remove (guid_Element1, guid_Element2)` (`ACAPinc.h`, AC25–AC30), “removes trimming connection between the elements” and takes no direction or trim type. | [#2365](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2365) |
| Read or set the joint type (Vertical Cut and the others) and the dx offset of a stair structure | Not possible | Nothing yet | `API_StairStructureType` (`APIdefs_Elements.h`, AC25–AC30) holds `structType`, `bottomType`, thicknesses, `role`, `side`, `isLanding`, `sequenceNumber`, `subElemId` and `API_SideStairStructData` or `API_MonolithStairStructData`; no field, enum or function for the joint type or dx. `GetGDLParametersOfElements` on stair structure sub-elements fails in Archicad 29 build 3200 (“Failed to get parameters of element”). | [#2536](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2536) |
| Change the baseline of an existing stair (move a flight end, a landing or a winder) and keep its GUID | Workaround | Recreate the stair on the new baseline with [RecreateStairs](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#RecreateStairs), which keeps its settings, Element ID, classifications, categories, properties and solid element operations, and returns the old and the new GUID. Its labels are lost. | The table of `ACAPI_Element_Change` (`ACAPinc.h`) does not list `API_StairID` among the types whose geometry or memo can change; there is no memo mask for `stairBaseLine` (only `APIMemoMask_StairRiser`, `StairTread` and `StairStructure`), and `ACAPI_Element_ChangeMemo` takes only `APIMemoMask_Polygon` (AC25–AC30). | [#2532](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2532) |
| Read which slab or stair edge a railing is linked to, or link a railing to one | Not possible | Read the slab's outline with [GetDetailsOfElements](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetDetailsOfElements) and create a static railing along the edge with [CreateRailings](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateRailings). When the slab changes, delete the railing and create it again. | `API_RailingType`, `API_RailingSegmentType` and `API_RailingNodeType` hold no host element or edge; the node has only `isStatic` (`APIdefs_Elements.h`, AC25–AC30). `ACAPI_Grouping_GetConnectedElements` and `ACAPI_Element_GetRelations` (`ACAPinc.h`) list no railing connection, and the `ACAPI::` modules have no railing API. | [#2445](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2445) |
| Turn off the automatic story visibility of a railing, so the stories it is shown on can be set | Not possible | Nothing yet | `API_RailingType` has `isAutoOnStoryVisibility` and `visibility` (`APIdefs_Elements.h`, AC27 and AC29), but Archicad 29 keeps `isAutoOnStoryVisibility` true after `ACAPI_Element_Change` (with and without the railing’s memo) and `ACAPI_Element_ChangeParameters`, and then ignores `visibility`. Archicad 30 is untested. | [#2448](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2448) |
| Set a label’s optimised position, “use text pen as uniform pen” of a symbol label, or a perpendicular text direction | Partly possible | Set the text direction (parallel, horizontal, vertical or a custom angle) with textWay in [CreateLabels](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateLabels) and [ModifyLabels](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ModifyLabels). When the symbol label’s library part has a parameter for the other two, set it with [SetGDLParametersOfElements](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#SetGDLParametersOfElements); otherwise set them in the Label tool settings or a favorite, and create the labels with favoriteName. | `API_LabelType` has no field for an optimised position or a uniform pen (`APIdefs_Elements.h`, AC25–AC30). Its `textWay` is documented for labels with only `APIDir_Parallel`, `APIDir_Horizontal`, `APIDir_Vertical` and `APIDir_General`, not `APIDir_Perpendicular`. | [#2666](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2666) |
| Set the Floor Plan Display, Show Projection, uncut and overhead lines or the cut line type of a mesh | Not possible | Nothing yet | `API_MeshType` has no `displayOption`, `viewDepthLimitation`, uncut or overhead (`aboveView*`) line pen or type, and no `sectContLtype` (`APIdefs_Elements.h`, AC25–AC30), as `API_ShellBaseType` of roofs and shells has. Its floor plan members are `contPen`, `ltypeInd`, `levelPen`, `sectContPen`, the cut fill pens, `visibilityCont`, `visibilityFill` and the cover fill, which [ModifyMeshes](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ModifyMeshes) writes. | [#2630](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2630) |
| Read or set the floor plan symbol of a railing: its break mark, which symbol components it shows, their 2D attributes and the symbol overrides | Not possible | Nothing yet | `API_RailingType` holds only `head`, `linkToSettings`, `defNode`, `defSegment`, `visibility`, `isAutoOnStoryVisibility`, `nVertices`, `referenceLinePen`, `contourPen`, `nNodes`, `nSegments` and `bottomOffset`; neither it nor `API_RailingSegmentType`, `API_RailingNodeType` and their post, rail, panel and baluster types has a break mark, symbol component, symbol override or 2D attribute field (`APIdefs_Elements.h`, AC25–AC30). | Create a radial dimension of an arc, a circle, a curved wall or a curved slab edge | Not documented | Place the radial dimension in Archicad and read it with [GetDetailsOfElements](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetDetailsOfElements), which returns how Archicad stored it. The only table of modifier values is the analytical model’s `API_AnalyticalCrossSection::profileParameters` (`APIdefs_AnalyticalModel.h`). | [#2587](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2587) |

For the hotlink check, read the state of each source with [GetHotlinkSourceStatus](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetHotlinkSourceStatus) (from Archicad 27). | `ACAPI_Window_Check` (`ACAPinc.h`, AC27–AC30; `ACAPI_ActionCenter_Check` in AC25–AC26) returns only an error code; `API_ActionCenterItemID` (`APIdefs_ActionCenter.hpp`) has only `APIActionCenterItem_Hotlinks`. | – |
| Load a new add-on (.apx or .bundle) while Archicad runs, from an add-on or a script | Not possible | Add it in Archicad's Add-On Manager (Options > Add-On Manager > Edit List of Available Add-Ons > Add). An add-on that is already loaded is replaced only after Archicad quits, as the Tapir Installer does when it updates Tapir. | Archicad loads an add-on itself and calls its `CheckEnvironment`, `RegisterInterface`, `Initialize` and `FreeData`; `API_AddonType` (`APIAddon_Normal`, `APIAddon_Preload`, `APIAddon_DontRegister`; `APIdefs_Registration.h`) and `ACAPI_KeepInMemory` (`ACAPinc.h`) only steer the add-on's own loading. No function loads, registers or reloads another add-on (AC25–AC30). | [#2732](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/2732) |

Found something else the Archicad API cannot do? Say so in an issue, with the DevKit headers you checked, and it is added here. [Open an issue](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/issues/new/choose)
